query: Before I change apps/backend/services/checkout.py, check .agents/plans and tell me which persistent plan, prerequisites, and downstream work this touches.
Create a persistent auth-session rollout plan under the repository planning system and make it depend on the existing identity-contract plan.
The payment-retry plan is finished. Close it, preview which completed prerequisite plans will be removed, then prune the closed tree.
Our old import design is wrong; replace the persistent legacy-import plan with streaming-import and preserve replacement lineage.
I renamed the cache invalidation plan ID. Update every persistent plan that requires it and validate there is no cycle.
Route my current staged and untracked frontend changes through the active implementation plans before deciding what to work on next.
The outcome of persona-matching is still right, but its scope and acceptance criteria changed. Revise that persistent plan in place and review affected dependents.
Show which repository plans are ready, which are waiting on active prerequisites, and the longest unresolved plan chain.
Run the persistent plan doctor: I suspect a dangling requires edge and someone may have created another .agents/plans inside apps/backend.
Find the relevant persistent plan for 'Korean grounding calibration' without mixing in my unrelated dirty checkout files.
Two of our persistent plans seem to cover the same checkout files; check the plan store for overlap conflicts before I continue.
Which repository plans have gone stale since the code they scope was rewritten? Audit .agents/plans before we resume the migration.
Write a short implementation plan in this chat for adding a retry helper; do not save any files.
Check whether any of my Kubernetes deployments have drifted from the manifests in the cluster.
Deduplicate the rows in customers.csv that share the same email address and save the result.
Draw a Mermaid dependency graph of the packages in package.json and explain circular npm dependencies.
Update the checklist in GitHub issue 184 after the release tasks were completed.
Review docs/design.md for architectural quality. This repository does not use persistent agent plans.
Make a project roadmap slide for executives using the milestones in roadmap.xlsx.
Explain directed acyclic graphs and topological sorting with a small Python example.
Use the repository's existing ADR index to record a new database decision; do not add another planning convention.
Run Terraform plan for the staging environment and summarize the resource changes.
Make a personal weekly to-do list from these notes and save it as notes/todo.md.
Compare these three design options and give me a peer-review recommendation, but don't edit the repo.
다른 워크트리에서 돌고 있는 에이전트들이 내가 고치려는 src/backend/report 쪽 파일을 건드리고 있는지, 그쪽 계획도 같이 봐 줘.
Three agents are working in parallel git worktrees of this repo. Before I land my branch, check whether any of them changed the same files or has an unlanded plan for them.
이 레포는 docs/plans 에 날짜 붙은 계획 문서를 쓴다. 지금 작업과 관련된 계획 문서를 찾아서 상태 줄부터 읽어 줘.
큰 작업이라 여러 단계로 나눠야 해. 코드 쓰기 전에 계획부터 세우고, 이미 있는 계획과 겹치는지 확인해 줘.
Our plans live in an ignored .plans/ folder in the main checkout. From this worktree, find which of them cover the files I'm changing.
Rename the local git branch feature/login to feature/sign-in and update its upstream.
